fine_lines.title: older vs younger
fine_lines.explanation_ar: older أكبر سنًّا، و younger أصغر سنًّا. نقول: my older brother (أخي الأكبر).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Older means more age. Younger means less age.

examples.sentence: My older sister is a doctor.
My younger brother is in primary school.

fine_lines.title: siblings vs cousins
fine_lines.explanation_ar: siblings هم إخوتك وأخواتك (لهم نفس والديك). cousins هم أبناء أعمامك وأخوالك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Siblings are your brothers and sisters. Cousins are children of your uncles and aunts.

examples.sentence: I have two siblings: a brother and a sister.
My cousins visit us every Eid.

expressions.phrase: Do you have a big family?
expressions.example: Do you have a big family? Yes, I have five siblings.

expressions.meaning_en: Say you have no brothers or sisters.
expressions.example: I'm an only child, so I play with my cousins.

expressions.meaning_en: Ask if someone has brothers or sisters.
expressions.example: Do you have any siblings? Yes, one sister.

expressions.phrase: That sounds like a big family.
expressions.meaning_en: React to what someone says about their family.
expressions.example: You have six siblings? That sounds like a big family.
My brothers and I always have fun together.
What do your parents do? My father is a pilot.

expressions.meaning_en: Show you think something is great.
expressions.example: Your mother is a chef? That's impressive!
We're having lunch on Friday. Would you like to come?
Would you like to come? I'd love to!

grammar.title: have / has and do / does for family
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم have مع I/you/we/they و has مع he/she/it: I have one brother. She has two sisters. وفي السؤال: Do you have...? / Does she have...? والجواب: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
grammar.explanation_en: Use have with I/you/we/they and has with he/she/it. Questions: Do you have...? Does she...?
examples: Do you have a big family? No, I don't.
I have one older brother and two younger sisters.
Does she cook at home? Yes, she does.

grammar.title: Talking about jobs: "My father is a pilot"
grammar.explanation_ar: للحديث عن المهنة: is + a/an + المهنة (My father is a pilot) أو works at + المكان (My father works at a bank). ومع he/she نضيف s للفعل: He flies, She works.
grammar.explanation_en: Jobs: is + a/an + job, or works at + place. Add -s with he/she: he flies, she works.
examples: She is a chef. She works at a restaurant downtown.
My mother is a high school teacher.

grammar.title: Possessive adjectives: my, your, his, her, our
grammar.explanation_ar: my (لي)، your (لك)، his (له)، her (لها)، our (لنا)، their (لهم). تأتي قبل الاسم: my brother, your parents.
grammar.explanation_en: Possessive adjectives go before a noun: my, your, his, her, our, their.
examples: My brother is my best friend.
